build.buildCommand: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@11.13.0 --activate && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm --filter @leanstart/backend-commons build && pnpm --filter @leanstart/auth-service exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter @leanstart/auth-service build

deploy.startCommand: pnpm --filter @leanstart/auth-service exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --filter @leanstart/auth-service start:prod
